step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify external actors/sources drawn on the board: Satellite dish (ThirdParty), Mobile phone (UserConsumerMobile), and End User person icon (UserConsumerWeb).
2. Identify AWS services drawn as boxes/icons: S3 (main bucket), S3 (Registry of Open Data), RDS (PostgreSQL GIS), Lambda, SageMaker, EC2, EKS, CloudFront.
3. Identify connections based on drawn pink arrows:
   - Satellite -> S3
   - Mobile -> PostgreSQL (RDS)
   - Lambda -> SageMaker
   - Registry of Open Data (S3) -> SageMaker
   - S3 <-> SageMaker (bidirectional inputs/outputs)
   - RDS <-> SageMaker (bidirectional inputs/outputs)
   - EC2 -> EKS -> CloudFront -> End User
4. Sequence connections logically following data ingestion, processing, and serving phases.
